title: Rich Orbon
paragraphs: “I am a retired Orthopedic Surgeon living in Scottsdale Arizona. Much of my youth was spent in the Northeast corridor from NYC to Boston. I have lived and studied in Europe and the States. I moved to the Southwest 14 years ago and started my artist career studying with Lorrie Putnam, Desmond O’Hagan, Scott Burdick, Matt Smith, Tim Rees, and Rose Franzen. My love of hiking and the outdoors has blended well with my enjoyment of plein air painting over studio art. I enjoy figure and life studies.”

bodyHtml:
“I am a retired Orthopedic Surgeon living in Scottsdale Arizona. Much of my youth was spent in the Northeast corridor from NYC to Boston. I have lived and studied in Europe and the States. I moved to the Southwest 14 years ago and started my artist career studying with Lorrie Putnam, Desmond O’Hagan, Scott Burdick, Matt Smith, Tim Rees, and Rose Franzen. My love of hiking and the outdoors has blended well with my enjoyment of plein air painting over studio art. I enjoy figure and life studies.”

The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists
551 Route 28
Harwich Port, MA
